description: Multimodal registration using NMI + MI. NMI is a histogram-based metric normalized for robustness across different acquisition protocols and modalities. Combine with standard MI for reinforced entropy-based alignment.
notes: NMI (--sigma / --sigmaderivative) uses a joint histogram; bin count is set by --nmibins (default 64). NMI does not use random subsampling. Prefer this over standard MI when the intensity relationship between modalities is non-linear or when normalisation robustness is important. Set --mainmetric 6 with derivativemode 2 to scale all gradients to the NMI reference.
